projects.title: Conviction
projects.summary: A real-time risk duel on Solana — two teams lock token baskets behind sealed threshold bands; whoever breaks out first auto-folds, the survivor mints the round's governance token.
projects.description: Two teams stake 2–3 SPL token baskets behind sealed threshold bands via MagicBlock Permissioned Ephemeral Rollups. Whoever's basket breaks the band first auto-folds and the survivor mints FTR — the round's governance token. 25-SPL curated universe, Birdeye live prices with seed-walk fallback, 10-route Next.js frontend, 25-instruction Anchor program with 10 state accounts. Shipped for MagicBlock Blitz v8.

cover.alt: Two opposing scoreboards with red and green threshold lines meeting at a tokenised chart.

projects.title: Meridian
projects.summary: A Solana CDP accepting BlackRock's BUIDL as collateral and minting a USD-pegged stablecoin — seven-program Anchor architecture with strict logic / custody separation.
projects.description: Accepts BlackRock's BUIDL (tokenized US Treasury fund) as collateral and mints TVLT, a USD-pegged stablecoin. Seven-program Anchor architecture with strict separation between logic and custody; permissionless liquidation, yield distribution, automated collateral monitoring, oracle checks (Pyth + Switchboard), reserve buffering, protocol solvency protections, PDAs, CPIs, fixed-point math, event-driven logic, multisig controls (Squads). Renamed from Meridian during a clearance pass — internal working name is Trevault / TVLT.

cover.alt: A vault door with a tokenised treasury certificate slotted into the central seal.

projects.title: CEX Demo
projects.summary: A full centralised exchange on Solana devnet — stateless actix-web API + stateful order-book server + settler worker bridged via Redis Streams.
projects.description: Three services: a stateless actix-web REST API, a stateful order-book matching engine, and a settler worker — all bridged via Redis Streams. Matching engine supports limit, market (IOC), stop, and stop-limit orders with FIFO price-time priority, partial fills, and self-match prevention. Anchor program handles deposit, withdraw, and settle_fill. Next.js 14 frontend with Phantom wallet and TradingView charts. Program ID: DNhvifJ6mcgVRRA4xaNKH82tjoHseN3GQKiLi8R7i6HY.
stack: Rust (actix-web, redis, tokio, ed25519-dalek, jsonwebtoken, rust_decimal)

cover.alt: A red and green order-book ladder stretching into the distance, neon-lit on a dark terminal screen.

projects.title: Web-based Wallet
projects.summary: A browser-based wallet covering both Solana and Ethereum — BIP-39 mnemonics, ed25519 / secp256k1 key derivation, in-browser key management.
projects.description: Browser-based wallet covering both Solana and Ethereum. BIP-39 mnemonic generation, ed25519-hd-key derivation for Solana, ethers for Ethereum signing, TweetNaCl primitives, Zustand state. Vite + React 19 + TypeScript.

cover.alt: A cryptographic keycard rendered as a glowing compass needle pointing at a wallet address.

projects.title: Rust Web Server
projects.summary: A multithreaded HTTP/1.1 server in Rust stdlib — custom reusable ThreadPool, function-pointer router, graceful shutdown. No external dependencies.
projects.description: Multithreaded HTTP/1.1 server written against only the Rust standard library. Custom reusable ThreadPool replacing thread-per-request, real HTTP parser, function-pointer router, generic handlers, named workers, graceful shutdown. Routes /, /sleep, /health, plus 404 / 405. Built from The Rust Book chapter 20 and extended.

cover.alt: An HTTP request arrow looping through a pool of worker threads, rendered on a black schematic.
